items.text: 应用内更新改用 electron-updater，稳定版清单和另一套发布协议一起保留。
items.textEn: In-app updates now go through electron-updater. The stable manifest and the second release protocol both stay.

items.text: 发布前校验 electron-updater 写出的更新元数据。
items.textEn: Release checks now validate the update metadata that electron-updater writes.

items.text: 稳定版改为晋升已经构建好的候选包，不再为 stable 重新打包。
items.textEn: A stable release promotes an existing candidate build instead of packaging again.

items.text: 增加每日自动发布。安装包要通过冒烟检查才进入发布。
items.textEn: Daily releases were added. An installer has to pass smoke checks before it is published.

items.text: 代码重构期间关掉每日发布的定时触发，手动触发仍可用。
items.textEn: The daily release schedule is off during the refactor. Manual runs still work.

items.text: 定时发布被一次合并重新打开后再次关掉。重构完成前，不再每天自动发到生产。
items.textEn: After a merge turned the daily schedule back on, it was removed again. Production builds are not published automatically each day while the refactor is open.

items.text: 发布收成两步：打 tag 先发 beta，再单独把该版本晋升为 stable。
items.textEn: Publishing is being cut down to two steps: a tag ships beta, then that build is promoted to stable.

items.text: 发布面向 Ubuntu 的 Linux 安装包，包含 .deb 和 AppImage，并写入签名后的稳定版更新清单。
items.textEn: Ubuntu-first Linux installers are published: .deb and AppImage, both listed in the signed stable update manifest.

items.text: 安装 .deb 前先结束旧进程。单实例锁失败时改为报错退出，不再静默关掉。
items.textEn: The .deb installer stops an older process before installing. If the single-instance lock fails, the app exits with an error instead of closing quietly.

items.text: 修正 AppImage 的启动和退出。
items.textEn: AppImage startup and shutdown were stabilized.

items.text: 发布流程补上 macOS Intel（x64）安装包和更新元数据。Intel 与 Apple Silicon 走同一套签名和稳定版门禁。
items.textEn: The release pipeline now builds macOS Intel (x64) installers and update metadata. Intel and Apple Silicon go through the same signing and stable gates.

items.text: Linux 安装路径改为从打包配置读取。
items.textEn: The installed Linux path is read from the packaging config.

items.text: macOS 公证票据装订失败时只重试装订，不再把整个包重新提交公证。
items.textEn: If stapling the macOS notarization ticket fails, the build retries the staple instead of submitting the package again.

items.text: Apple 公证校验接口丢响应时，改为重试票据校验。
items.textEn: Ticket validation retries when Apple's notarization endpoint drops the response.

items.text: 公证改到签名完成后的 afterSign 钩子里执行，并保留装订重试。
items.textEn: Notarization runs in the afterSign hook, after signing, and still retries stapling.

items.text: 本地推理运行时改为使用 llama.cpp 官方发布的文件。
items.textEn: The local inference runtime now uses official llama.cpp release files.

items.text: 安装包改为不内置 llama.cpp。第一次使用本地推理时，按需下载预编译运行时。
items.textEn: The installer no longer bundles llama.cpp. The prebuilt runtime is downloaded the first time local inference is used.

items.text: 可以卸载运行时、指定可执行文件路径，并重新发现本机已有的 llama.cpp。
items.textEn: The runtime can be uninstalled, pointed at a chosen executable, or discovered again on the machine.

items.text: 支持导入本机已有的 llama.cpp，安装说明按操作系统分开写。
items.textEn: An existing local llama.cpp can be imported. The setup notes differ by operating system.

items.text: 切换推理后端前先停掉正在运行的本地服务。已经装好的后端不再重走完整安装进度。
items.textEn: Switching inference backends stops the local service first. A backend that is already installed skips the full install progress.

items.text: 工作模式下，本地模型上下文过小时只输出 1 个 token 就结束任务，界面没有明显报错。
items.textEn: In work mode, a too-small local context ends the task after one token, and the app does not show a clear error.

items.text: 缩小 Windows 离线安装包。Git、Python 和共享技能环境改用 solid 7z，只在安装时整包解压。
items.textEn: The Windows offline installer is smaller. Git, Python, and the shared skill environment use solid 7z and are unpacked in full at install time.

items.text: Windows 安装包继续收紧压缩。Electron 只携带 8 个语言包，并去掉生产环境的 source map。
items.textEn: Windows installer compression was tightened further. Electron ships 8 locales, and production source maps are removed.

items.text: 缩短 Windows 安装耗时。安装过程不再写入 Defender 排除项。
items.textEn: The Windows installer runs faster, and it no longer adds a Defender exclusion.
